properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1028533
Incident Time: 2012-10-26 17:45:00
Nearest City: Corpus Christi, TX
Location: RETUN AND FILL AREA AT THE SAFETY-KLEEN FACILITY IN CORPUS CHRISTI TX 3820 BRATTON ROAD
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: MIXED/WASTE SOLVENTS - POSS. CON
Medium Affected: SOIL
Suspected Responsible Party:
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 27.695556, -97.418889 (Explicit)
Reported Spill Volume: 50 gallons
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** EMPLOYEE WAS ATTEMPTING TO OFFLOAD WASTE SOLVENT AT THE FACILITY. HE USED A PUMP TO ATTEMPT TO UNCLOG THE UNIT WHERE THE SOLVENT IS DISPENSED INTO PRIOR TO BEING SENT TO THE STORAGE TANK. EMPLOYEE STARTED THE PUMP AND WAS UNAWARE THAT THE HOSE THAT WAS CONNECTED TO THE PUMP WAS RELEASING THE WASTE SOLVENT OUTSIDE OF THE CONTAINMENT AREA. APPROXIMATELY 50 GALLONS OF WASTE SOLVENT WERE RELEASED. NO MATERIAL ENTERED ANY WATER WAY. AN EMERGENCY CONTRACTOR WAS CALLED IN AND DISPATCHED AT THE TIME OF THE SPILL (MILLER ENVIRONMENTAL). THE RELEASED MATERIAL (WASTE SOLVENT) WAS ABSORBED ALONG WITH CLAY AND SOIL THAT WAS EXAVATED TO CLEAN THE AREA WHERE THE WASTE SOLVENT WAS RELEASED. TCEQ WAS CONTACTED AT THE TIME OF THE SPILL FOR NOTIFICATION PURPOSES.

properties.content:
Report Details

Incident Time: 2012-01-08 19:23:00

Medium Affected: LAND

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 36.013121, -84.267875 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Report Description
"I AM A FORMER EMPLOYEE OF THE COMPANY AND KNOW THAT THEY ARE SENDING CONTAMINATED MATERIAL, RADIOACTIVE IN NATURE, TO A SUPPOSEDLY CLEAN LANDFILL. THIS LANDFILL IS LOCATED IN ANDERSON COUNTY AND THEY ARE ACCOMPLISHING THIS THROUGH SHIELDING SOME OF THE CONTAMINATION IS FIXED AND SOME LOOSE HOWEVER IT IS ABOVE RELEASE LIMITS AND ONCE PAST THE SCALES LOCATED AT THE BOTTOM OF THE HILL THE LOAD IS NOT CHECKED AGAIN. THEY EVEN KNOW WHERE TO LOCATE IT IN THE BOX IN ORDER TO NOT BE DETECTED. DUE TO FINANCIAL HARDSHIP THE COMPANY CANNOT AFFORD TO DISPOSE OF THE WASTE PROPERLY. THE COMPANY IS ALSO LYING TO THE STATE CONCERNING AGED WASTE STORED AS THIS IS A MAJOR FINE AND CANNOT PROCESS AND DISPOSE OF THE WASTE DUE TO LIMITED CAPABILITIES AND A LACK OF DISPOSAL METHODS. ONE OF THE MANAGERS IS A MAYOR OF ONE OF THE LOCAL TOWNS AND SEEMS TO KNOW HIS WAY AROUND THE RULES. DUE TO THESE SHADY WAYS OF CONDUCTING BUSINESS I NO LONGER WISH TO BE ASSOCIATED WITH THIS COMPANY. I REMEMBER THE COMPANY NAME AS THEY MADE THE PAPER AWHILE BACK BECAUSE THEY OWED CLOSE TO A MILLION DOLLARS TO THE IRS IN BACK TAXES AND ALL ACTIVITIES WERE ABOUT TO BE FROZEN UNTIL PAID. THE COMPANY IS LOCATED AT THE K25 FACILITY IN OAK RIDGE TN. "

properties.title: NRC Report: Carbon Monoxide near Keene, NH
properties.summary: Incident Type: PIPELINE - NRC Report ID: 1136250 - Medium Affected: AIR - Suspected Responsible Party: LIBERTY UTILITIES
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1136250
Incident Time: 2015-12-19 09:00:00
Nearest City: Keene, NH
Location: 80 PEARL ST.
Incident Type: PIPELINE
Material: CARBON MONOXIDE
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: LIBERTY UTILITIES
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 42.929659, -72.290781 (Approximated from route)
Report Description
LIBERTY UTILITIES SUPPLIES GAS SERVICE TO THE CITY OF KEENE THROUGH A STAND-ALONE DISTRIBUTION SYSTEM USING A PROPANE-AIR MIXTURE. THE COMPRESSED AIR SUPPLY TO THE SYSTEM WAS LOST FOR A SHORT TIME RESULTING IN HIGHER BTU GAS BEING SENT INTO THE SYSTEM. THIS CAUSED INCOMPLETE BURNING AT THE BURNER TIPS. COMPANY ALARMS WENT OFF, CREWS RESPONDED. 911 CALLS WERE MADE FROM CITIZENS. THE SYSTEM RETURNED TO FUNCTION ON ITS OWN, HOWEVER, RICH GAS HAD TO BE PURGED. APPROXIMATELY 50 CUSTOMERS GAS HAD TO BE PHYSICALLY TURNED OFF BY FIRE DEPARTMENT. FOUR INJURIES REPORTED FOR CARBON MONOXIDE EXPOSURE AND WERE LATER RELEASED. ROUGHLY 50 CUSTOMERS (BUSINESSES, RESTAURANTS, HOMES ETC.) WERE EVACUATED. COMPANY PERSONNEL RESPONDED WITH LOCAL EMERGENCY RESPONDERS TO CONTAIN THE INCIDENT AND RESTORE THE SYSTEM TO NORMAL OPERATION. EXTENT OF DAMAGES ARE NOT KNOWN AT THIS TIME, BUT ARE NOT EXPECTED TO BE SIGNIFICANT.
